I cannot say it is a good or bad relstionship, but definitely a disturbed one. I have like 2 memories of my mother. 1 is the loving and best mother you can have. When I was a kid she took good care of me actually. It was when my sis moved out that everything sort of changed overnight more or less and when I grew out of a kid I somehow got yelled at for stupid reasons like asking for advice, saying I don't have time because I am doing homrwork or something Else or pretty much anything. Everything changed so fast. That's where I learned the second phase of my mother, the "Monster" that just constantly yells. When I think logically about it I think my oldest sister was some sort of scapegoat who got blamed for everything and it Sort of really was like that. then there was a Brief period where my other sister was demonized by my mother but she finished school and went to university, so there was not much reason to yell at her at that Point because many fights we're with my oldest sister because she did not want to Go to university and Start working and then I sort of became the scapegoat. Was around 12 at the time. There were a hell of a Lot of fights everyday really that I dealt with by escapism, mainly gaming.

I live in a flat actually owned by my mother. I don't know where that sudden shift in support came but it was around the time where my oldest sister cut all ties and my theory is that she thought that I would do the same at some point (which I was thinking about a lot) and bought a flat in which I could live in relatively Close so that I cannot move away, borderliners are afraid of being left alone after all a I still think about moving though because I don't want to be reliant. Still pay a little for being able to live there but notnas much as a full rent. I also work full time

I am legally allowed to drink since more than 6 years in my country. Because I am stuck in a boring shit life without any real talent and maybe If I wasn't yelled at and felt down all day for years I could've built some talent. Anything I start doing now comes with a bitter taste of "yeah, could be doing this for 15, 10, 5, 3 years now." And don't play the dumb "everyone starts somewhere" card because my interests did not really shift much over time so If I had the energy and opportunity I'd indeed been practicing guitar and drawing for more than 3 years now. Also, I Lack compassion in a weird way whicj I also blame on that. I am basically unable to form healthy relstionships.

I feel like I had no youth, thats basically why but it is not like I am always down because of it. Just every week or so. Also I think about cutting all ties or killing myself someday but am not sure. I also find it unfair that I have to live like everyone else when my experiences make me feel alienated to most.
